authorization: W1-P1.6 Task 3 GO from Lead final acceptance review of T2-R1 (44dc148). Scope: core package import-time safety and deferred-DOM-access characterization in a genuine Node environment; public surface only. T4 (closure) and everything downstream remain NO-GO.

environment.environment: node (real Node process — // @vitest-environment node in the spec, and `environment: 'node'` in vitest.ssr.config.ts)
environment.documentGlobal: undefined (asserted at test start before any import)
environment.windowGlobal: undefined (asserted at test start before any import)
environment.isolatedProject: packages/core/vitest.ssr.config.ts — NO setupFiles (the shared tests/setup.ts imports the web components, which extend HTMLElement and throw at import in a no-DOM process). The spec is EXCLUDED from packages/core/vitest.config.ts so the jsdom suite never picks it up.

publicImportTarget.note: The package ENTRY is the mandatory target (API-075). The two utility modules are additionally imported to characterize WHICH modules are import-safe and to drive the deferred-call-time proof (API-076).

observedResults.precondition: typeof document === 'undefined', typeof window === 'undefined', typeof HTMLElement === 'undefined' — proven at test start.
observedResults.securityModuleImport: OK — imports without touching document/window at module-evaluation time; escapeHTML and sanitizeHTML are functions.
observedResults.cspStylesModuleImport: OK — imports without DOM; applyClasses is a function; shadowDOMStyles is a string; defaultTheme is an object.
observedResults.packageEntryImport: THROWS ReferenceError (HTMLElement is not defined). The entry re-exports web components whose class declarations `extend HTMLElement` (evaluated at import). This is a genuine import-time browser dependency — recorded as a LIMITATION, NOT claimed as SSR-safe.
observedResults.deferredDomAccess: escapeHTML('x') and createElement('div') throw ReferenceError / 'document is not defined' at CALL time (deferred), while import succeeds — proving DOM access happens at call time, not import time.
observedResults.nonDomUtilities: escapeAttribute, containsSuspiciousPatterns, defaultTheme/shadowDOMStyles, and duck-typed applyClasses/hasOverflowHiddenAncestor operate normally in a no-DOM process.

contractEvidence.testId: packages/core/tests/w1-p1-6-t3-ssr-import-safety.spec.ts#API-075: the package ENTRY import THROWS in no-DOM Node (limitation recorded, not claimed safe)
contractEvidence.asserts: The pure utility modules (security.ts, csp-styles.ts) import without a DOM (no top-level browser access); the package ENTRY (index.ts) import THROWS a ReferenceError on HTMLElement in a no-DOM Node process. Precondition asserts no document/window/HTMLElement before import.
contractEvidence.negativePath: The package entry import is observably NOT safe (throws ReferenceError) — recorded, not claimed safe. Utility modules ARE import-safe.
contractEvidence.limitation: Package entry import-safety is NOT satisfied today: index.ts re-exports components whose class declarations extend HTMLElement at module-evaluation time. Fixing this is a PRODUCTION change and is OUT OF SCOPE for this characterization (Task 3 makes no production edits).
supplementaryTests: packages/core/tests/w1-p1-6-t3-ssr-import-safety.spec.ts#API-075: runs without document/window before any import (precondition)
packages/core/tests/w1-p1-6-t3-ssr-import-safety.spec.ts#API-075: the security utility module imports without a DOM (no top-level browser access)
packages/core/tests/w1-p1-6-t3-ssr-import-safety.spec.ts#API-075: the csp-styles utility module imports without a DOM (no top-level browser access)

contractEvidence.testId: packages/core/tests/w1-p1-6-t3-ssr-import-safety.spec.ts#API-076: DOM-dependent helpers throw ReferenceError at CALL time (deferred, not import)
contractEvidence.asserts: Utility modules import successfully in no-DOM Node (deferred); calling a document-dependent helper (escapeHTML, createElement) throws a ReferenceError at call time, not at import; non-DOM helpers and duck-typed element operations work normally without a global DOM.
contractEvidence.negativePath: DOM-dependent calls fail observably at call time (ReferenceError: document is not defined) — no silent failure, no import-time failure.
contractEvidence.limitation: Scope is the utility modules (security.ts, csp-styles.ts) reachable without the package entry. The package entry itself cannot be imported in no-DOM Node today (see API-075); its deferred-access behavior is therefore characterized via the utility modules it re-exports.
supplementaryTests: packages/core/tests/w1-p1-6-t3-ssr-import-safety.spec.ts#API-076: non-DOM helpers operate normally in a no-DOM process (facilities they need are present)
